cases.sentence: ___ взяли лампы, но не взяли для них масла.
cases.explain: «Глупые девушки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

cases.sentence: Девушки с зажженными лампами вошли с ним на ___, и дверь за ними закрылась.
cases.explain: «свадебный пир» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

cases.sentence: Позже вернулись и ___ и стали просить: «Господин!
cases.explain: «остальные девушки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

cases.sentence: Тогда Он скажет и тем, кто будет по левую сторону: «Идите от Меня, проклятые, в ___, приготовленный для дьявола и его ангелов.
cases.explain: «вечный огонь» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
